legal.englishOnlyNotice: This document is currently available in English only.
legal.visitorNoticeBody: Checking in records the action, the time (set by our server, not your device), and this location in a permanent, append-only log. We also record a device identifier, your IP address, and browser information — this confirms the check-in is real, not to track you elsewhere. This information is visible to the organization operating this system and is not shared with anyone else.
legal.fullTextApplies: The full text below is what applies.

landing.heroSubhead: A free check-in/out platform for any space. Passkeys, QR and kiosk flows make entry effortless; server-authoritative time and a tamper-evident audit trail make the record impossible to quietly rewrite.
landing.visitorPrompt: Here to check in? Point your phone's camera at the QR code posted at your location — it opens your check-in directly.
landing.visitorScanLink: If it doesn't open, scan it here
landing.pairingHeading: Frictionless at the door. Certain in the record.
landing.pairingSubhead: Most systems trade one for the other — a fast turnstile with a soft log, or a rigorous log nobody wants to use. The same event is both here, and that pairing is the whole product.
landing.qrDetail: Printed room codes or live kiosk
landing.footerTagline: Free check-in/out platform · Immutable by design
